route.rationale: three small Rust changes in cap, herding run and the worker guard

cells.title: Name every missing cap answer in one refusal

truths: cap_cell_from_flags in handlers_close.rs evaluates the mistakes answer, the principles answer, the principles-arm answer, the proof floor, the finish commit trailer and the sync door without returning at the first, and refuses once with one text that lists each problem and its fix flag

state refusals (cell not found, already capped or dropped, archived, claim ownership, report shape, verify mismatch, design, advisor nudge, departure door, NEEDS_REVISION judge, inline and lane checks) keep their order and still refuse alone
the judge override decision (log_decision near line 513) is written only after every check has passed
existing tests that pin a single refusal text are updated to the combined text and pass
must_haves.why: About 20 leader calls in token-spend-cuts were refuse-then-retry on cap answers (D1).

cells.action: Implement CONTEXT.md D1 in packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/cells/handlers_close.rs cap_cell_from_flags (line 256). The missing-answer checks today are: read_mistakes_answer (line 385), read_principles_used_answer (line 388), the finish commit trailer (lines 415-435), the proof floor (lines 459-464), the principles arm (lines 465-469), and the sync door (lines 871-896). Collect their refusal texts into a Vec in their current order and, after the last of them, refuse once when the Vec is not empty: first line 'capCell: cell "<id>" needs N answer(s) before it caps:' then one line per problem, each keeping its existing text and fix. Keep every other refusal where it is. Move the judge override side effect (log_decision near line 513) after the sync door so nothing is written when any check refuses. Update existing assertions in verbs/cells/tests.rs that break; add no new tests (lct-5 owns them). Locate with rg -n and read ranges only. Write no code comment. Run only the cell verify, never the full suite. One commit with the cell trailer, files staged by explicit path. In the result, put principles_used ([] when none) and, if the cap door asks, sync_ack.

cells.title: Let herding run cap with the worker's own answers
cells.verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --bin bee -- herding::run herding::mailbox

truths: try_cap_finished_cell in herding/run.rs passes the worker result's principles_used array to the cap (an empty array answers no principle used) and its sync_ack string when present

when the auto-settle cap refuses, herding run prints the cap refusal text and a bee cells finish command carrying --from-job, --proof-result with the parsed label, --no-mistakes, and each flag the refusal names (--principle-used or --no-principle-used, --sync-ack), in place of the fixed hint
the cell brief's result contract (render_brief in herding/mailbox.rs) names principles_used and sync_ack as result fields with one line on when to fill each, and the result parser accepts them
existing tests that pin the old hint or the old result schema are updated and pass
must_haves.why: 6 of 8 token-spend-cuts workers returned done without a cap; each cost the leader finish calls (D2).

cells.action: Implement CONTEXT.md D2. In packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/herding/run.rs try_cap_finished_cell (lines 6142-6213) fill CapFlags principle_used / no_principle_used and sync_ack from the parsed mailbox result fields principles_used (array of strings; empty means no principle used) and sync_ack (non-blank string). When finish_cap_and_release refuses, replace the fixed hint at line 6384 with the refusal text plus one bee cells finish command line that carries every flag the refusal names. In packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/herding/mailbox.rs add the two optional fields to the result type near line 545 and to the result contract text near line 430 (one line each: principles_used lists the principle slugs that changed a decision, [] for none; sync_ack gives the reason when the cap sync door asks). Update existing assertions that break; add no new tests (lct-5 owns them). Locate with rg -n and read ranges only. Write no code comment. Run only the cell verify, never the full suite. One commit with the cell trailer, files staged by explicit path. In the result, put principles_used ([] when none) and, if the cap door asks, sync_ack.

cells.title: Stop a herded cell worker from starting the full suite
cells.verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --bin bee -- hooks::worker_guard full_suite

truths: the worker guard in hooks/worker_guard.rs, for a herded worker whose job carries a cell id, refuses a Bash command when any segment (split and env-stripped the way verbs/cells/validate.rs verify_segments and strip_env_assignments do) equals a declared commands.test entry, bee test or .bee/bin/bee test
it does not refuse when that cell has a non-blank full_suite_reason, when the job has no cell id, or for a cargo test command with a filter
the refusal text names the full suite, says it runs once per feature through bee test, and names the cell verify to run
the segment test is one shared function used by both validate.rs full_suite_verify_problem and the guard
must_haves.why: The token-spend-cuts tester ran the full suite, went idle twice and lost its result (D3).

cells.action: Implement CONTEXT.md D3. Factor the full-suite segment test out of packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/cells/validate.rs full_suite_verify_problem (lines 183-204, helpers verify_segments line 172 and strip_env_assignments line 143) into one pub(crate) fn that takes a command string and the declared commands.test list. In packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/hooks/worker_guard.rs run (line 16), for a herded worker (BEE_HERDING_WORKER set) find the job's cell id the way herding already exposes it to the worker (find with rg -n for the env or job.json the worker reads, for example in herding/run.rs), load that cell from the control root store, and refuse a Bash tool call whose command matches, unless the cell has a non-blank full_suite_reason. Reuse the existing denial output shape and exit code. Update existing assertions that break; add no new tests (lct-5 owns them). Locate with rg -n and read ranges only. Write no code comment. Run only the cell verify, never the full suite. One commit with the cell trailer, files staged by explicit path. In the result, put principles_used ([] when none) and, if the cap door asks, sync_ack.
